nodes.description: Ownership address stored in Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Mapping of token holder balances in GT contract.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances owner=>spender=>amount in GT contract.
Total token supply, fixed at construction time.
Token symbol string, set to 'GT' in constructor.
Token name string, set to 'General Token' in constructor.
Token decimals, set to 8 in constructor.
Owned contract constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer, requires msg.sender == newOwner, then sets owner and clears newOwner.
GT constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, total supply and owner balance.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
Returns the token balance of a given address from balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to `to` using SafeMath.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender.
ERC20 transferFrom moving tokens from `from` to `to` and decrementing allowance.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowance then performs an external call to receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token contract.
SafeMath.add library function implementing checked addition.
SafeMath.sub library function implementing checked subtraction.
SafeMath.mul library function implementing checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div library function implementing checked division.
External caller address, untrusted input used across ownership and token logic.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval passing user-controlled spender.
External call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer on an arbitrary token contract address.
Addition c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a) in SafeMath.add.
Subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) in SafeMath.sub.
Multiplication c = a * b guarded by overflow check in SafeMath.mul.
Division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0) in SafeMath.div.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to authorize ownership acceptance.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] with caller-supplied influence.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
newOwner state variable is compared against msg.sender in acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership copies newOwner into owner then resets newOwner.
`to` destination parameter drives balances[to] update in transfer.
`tokens` amount parameter drives the SafeMath operations in transfer.
`spender` parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
`tokens` parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
`from` parameter is the source account debited in transferFrom.
`to` parameter is the destination account credited in transferFrom.
`tokens` parameter controls debits and allowance reduction in transferFrom.
`spender` parameter is used as the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
`tokens` parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
`data` parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary contract targeted by the external transfer call.
`tokens` parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping read by allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping read by allowance.
Parameter a feeds the unchecked-style addition in SafeMath.add.
Parameter b feeds the addition in SafeMath.add.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b feeds the subtraction and bounds check in SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication and overflow check in SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a is the dividend in SafeMath.div.
Parameter b is the divisor checked by require(b > 0) in SafeMath.div.
Result of the checked addition is stored in local c of SafeMath.add.
Result of the checked subtraction is stored in local c of SafeMath.sub.
Result of the checked multiplication is stored in local c of SafeMath.mul.
Result of the checked division is stored in local c of SafeMath.div.
SafeMath.add body executes the arithmetic addition operation.
SafeMath.sub body executes the arithmetic subtraction operation.
SafeMath.mul body executes the arithmetic multiplication operation.
SafeMath.div body executes the arithmetic division operation.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens).
transfer calls SafeMath.add for balances[to].add(tokens).
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add for the destination credit.
totalSupply calls SafeMath.sub on _totalSupply and balances[address(0)].
approveAndCall performs an external callback into receiveApproval of the spender contract after state update.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
owner state variable is used as the recipient of the external token transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balances state mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances state mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances state mapping.
approve writes the allowed state mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed state mapping.
allowance reads the allowed state mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed state mapping before the callback.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
GT constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply value.
GT constructor credits balances[owner] with the total supply.
GT constructor sets the symbol state variable.
GT constructor sets the name state variable.
GT constructor sets the decimals state variable.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership writes the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner state variable.
Owned constructor initializes the owner state variable.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the transfer destination.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only exists to be stored into newOwner by transferOwnership, so it is normalized into that function.
The `to` parameter is a direct argument of transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The `tokens` parameter is consumed only inside transfer's SafeMath expression.
The `spender` parameter exists solely as an index used by approve.
The `tokens` parameter is only written into the allowed mapping by approve.
The `from` parameter is a direct operand of transferFrom's balance and allowance updates.
The `to` parameter is a direct operand of transferFrom's balance credit.
The `tokens` parameter is only used inside transferFrom's arithmetic.
The `spender` parameter becomes the external callback target, so it merges into the unsafe external call node.
The `tokens` parameter is only used for the allowance write and callback argument in approveAndCall.
The `data` parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call, tying it to that unsafe operation.
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract invoked by the external transfer call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The `tokens` parameter is only forwarded as an argument of transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokenOwner parameter is only used to look up the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
The spender parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter a of the library addition is only meaningful inside SafeMath.add.
Parameter b of the library addition is only meaningful inside SafeMath.add.
Parameter a of the library subtraction is only meaningful inside SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b of the library subtraction is only meaningful inside SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a of the library multiplication is only meaningful inside SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b of the library multiplication is only meaningful inside SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a of the library division is only meaningful inside SafeMath.div.
Parameter b of the library division is only meaningful inside SafeMath.div.
Local c only holds the result of the addition operation in SafeMath.add.
Local c only holds the result of the subtraction operation in SafeMath.sub.
Local c only holds the result of the multiplication operation in SafeMath.mul.
Local c only holds the result of the division operation in SafeMath.div.
